rows.grounds: absolutive expressing prior action of arrival
first-person speaker as agent of the action
locative compound indicating the ritual location
perfect verb denoting completed mantra recitation

items.question: What mantra practice did the speaker undertake at the sacred yoni-seat?
premises: The speaker arrived at the yoni-seat.
The speaker performed an act of chanting.
The object chanted was the mantra of Kālikā.
items.inference: Upon arriving at the yoni-seat, the speaker chanted the Kālikā mantra.
uncertainties: The form 'haṃ' is taken as a variant of the first-person pronoun 'aham'.
items.plain_english: Having come to the yoni-seat, I chanted the mantra of Kālikā.
